record.paper_title: Topological Open Problems in the Geometry of Banach Spaces
record.context_brief: Replacing Kuratowski noncompactness in LUR criteria
record.original_question: Let X be a normed space and suppose that, for every ε>0, X can be written as a countable union X=∪_{n=1}∞ X_{n,ε} such that for every x∈X_{n,ε} there is a σ(X,F)-open half-space H containing x for which a chosen measure of noncompactness of H∩X_{n,ε} is less than ε. Replace the Kuratowski index α in this condition by one of the indices λ, β, or χ, where β measures distance to a uniform Eberlein compact set, χ measures distance to a weakly compact set, and λ measures coverability by countably many small-diameter sets. Under any of these three replacement hypotheses, do the norm-Borel and weak-Borel sets of X coincide? Is the identity map from X with its weak topology σ(X,X*) to X with the norm topology σ-continuous? Does X admit an equivalent locally uniformly rotund norm, and, if so, what corresponding network characterizations hold?

evidence.quote: Theorem 6. (See [5]) Let X be a normed space and let F be a norming subspace of its dual. Then X admits an equivalent σ(X, F)-lower semi-continuous LUR norm if, and only if, for every ε > 0 we can write X = ∪∞ n=1 Xn,ε in such a way that for every x ∈ Xn,ε, there exists a σ(X, F)-open half space H containing x with α (H ∩ Xn,ε) < ε.

β(B) := inf{ε > 0 : B ⊆ K + εBX where K is a uniform Eberlein compact}. Another one is the distance to a weakly compact subset of the normed space: χ(B) := inf{ε > 0 : B ⊆ K + εBX where K is a weakly compact subset}, or the separability index measuring the distance to separable subsets: λ(B) := inf{ε > 0 : B ⊆ ∪∞ i=1Ai such that diam(Ai) ≤ ε}.

Question 10. Given a normed space X that verifies the conditions of Theorem 6 with the index λ (resp. β, χ) instead of α. Is it true that the Borel sets for the norm and the σ(X, X∗) topology coincide? Is the identity map Id : (X(σ(X, X∗)) → (X, k · k) σ-continuous? Doest X admit an equivalent LUR norm? In case of positive answers to any of the above questions what can be said for the network characterizations?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a normed space with topological dual $X^*$. For a bounded subset $B\subseteq X$ define the following four indices of "noncompactness":
- Kuratowski index: $\alpha(B)=\inf\{\varepsilon>0: B=\bigcup_{i=1}^{n}B_i\text{ with }\operatorname{diam}(B_i)\le\varepsilon\}$.
- Separability index: $\lambda(B)=\inf\{\varepsilon>0: B\subseteq\bigcup_{i=1}^{\infty}A_i\text{ with }\operatorname{diam}(A_i)\le\varepsilon\}$.
- Distance to uniform Eberlein compacta: $\beta(B)=\inf\{\varepsilon>0: B\subseteq K+\varepsilon B_X\text{ for some uniform Eberlein compact }K\subseteq X\}$.
- Distance to weakly compact sets: $\chi(B)=\inf\{\varepsilon>0: B\subseteq K+\varepsilon B_X\text{ for some weakly compact }K\subseteq X\}$.

Say that $X$ has property $P_\gamma$ (for $\gamma\in\{\alpha,\lambda,\beta,\chi\}$) if for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists a countable decomposition $X=\bigcup_{n=1}^{\infty}X_{n,\varepsilon}$ such that for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and every $x\in X_{n,\varepsilon}$ there is a $\sigma(X,X^*)$-open half-space $H$ with $x\in H$ and $\gamma(H\cap X_{n,\varepsilon})<\varepsilon$.

It is known that $P_\alpha$ is equivalent to the existence of an equivalent $\sigma(X,X^*)$-lower semicontinuous locally uniformly rotund (LUR) norm on $X$. Assume now that $X$ satisfies $P_\lambda$ (respectively $P_\beta$, respectively $P_\chi$). For each of these three hypotheses, decide:

(a) Do the norm-Borel $\sigma$-algebra and the weak-Borel $\sigma$-algebra of $X$ coincide?

(b) Is the identity map $\mathrm{Id}:(X,\sigma(X,X^*))\to(X,\|\cdot\|)$ $\sigma$-continuous, i.e., is $X$ a countable union of subsets on each of which the identity is weak-to-norm continuous?

(c) Does $X$ admit an equivalent LUR norm?

(d) In case of an affirmative answer to any of (a)–(c), determine the corresponding network characterizations of these properties.
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search located related work on the JNR property, σ-fragmentability, and coincidence of weak/norm Borel structures in Banach spaces, as well as Kuratowski-index characterizations of LUR renormability, but did not surface a definitive resolution of the question with the indices λ, β, χ in place of α. The current status is therefore not conclusively established from the search.

status_evidence.title: Kuratowski's Index of Non-Compactness and Renorming in Banach Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Characterization of LUR renormability via the Kuratowski index α.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the α-version of the criterion, which is the starting point of the question.

status_evidence.title: The JNR property and the Borel structure of a Banach space
status_evidence.snippet: JNR property, σ-fragmentability, and coincidence of weak/norm Borel sets are topological invariants of the weak topology.
status_evidence.claim: Related framework concerning weak-vs-norm Borel coincidence, but does not resolve the λ/β/χ versions.
